# pangolin_ai_providers (Data Source)

Lists the AI providers of the organization (AI gateway). The upstream API key and the custom headers are not part of the list and are never exposed here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Names of every enabled OpenAI provider.
data "pangolin_ai_providers" "all" {}

output "openai_provider_names" {
  value = [for p in data.pangolin_ai_providers.all.providers : p.name if p.type == "openai" && p.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `query` (String) Only return providers whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) List of AI providers, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `auth_type` (String) How the gateway authenticates to the upstream.
- `capabilities` (List of String) Capabilities enabled on the provider.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The numeric provider ID.
- `name` (String) The provider name.
- `nice_id` (String) Readable ID, unique per org.
- `routing_mode` (String) How requests are routed to the upstream.
- `skip_tls_verification` (Boolean) Whether the upstream TLS certificate is not verified.
- `type` (String) The provider type (e.g. `openai`, `anthropic`, `custom`).
- `upstream_url` (String) The upstream base URL, or `null` for the type default.
